NAWODHAN is an initiative aimed at fostering a vibrant agribusiness ecosystem in Kerala. It provides comprehensive support to farmers, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), agripreneurs, consumers, and landowners. The program includes technical assistance, financial support, and market access, focusing on sustainable farming practices, demand-driven crop models, and enhancing overall farming efficiency. Additionally, it has established a Grievance Redressal Mechanism to address the concerns of all stakeholders fairly and efficiently.
